name: 4932-prefillheavy-qwen2572b-tp8
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, bf16. ~145 GB of weights, ~18.2 GB per card at TP8. Ungated on HF.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=192, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 1500 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix reuse: prompt mean 2000 stdev 1155 clipped to [64, 4000], output mean 100 stdev 58 clipped to [16, 200], `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing long single-turn reports with a 72B model, 192 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct

tp-size: 8

# Pinned; the default at this commit is flashinfer. This backend asserts SM>=90 and refuses
# multimodal, FP8 and speculative decoding, none of which are used here. Its compiled kernels
# are a build hazard -- see configs/env.yaml.
attention-backend: fa3
